relations.text: SynapticsがIoT向けWi-Fi事業の資産取得と非独占ライセンス取得でBroadcomと契約し、対価は現金2億30万ドルで2025年1月30日に完了した
relations.text_en: Synaptics entered into asset purchase agreements with Broadcom for certain assets and non-exclusive licenses relating to its Wi-Fi Business in the IoT market, for $200.3 million in cash, closed January 30, 2025

source.label: Synaptics 10-K
source.quote: On January 19, 2025, we entered into definitive asset purchase agreements with Broadcom to acquire certain assets, and obtain non-exclusive licenses relating to, Broadcom’s Wi-Fi Business in the IoT market for an aggregate consideration of $ 200.3 million in cash, which closed on January 30, 2025 (“Closing Date”).

relations.text: 両社が移行サービスを相互に提供し、Broadcomが仕入先への発注を支援する1年間の在庫供給契約も含まれる
relations.text_en: Both parties provide transition services to one another, including a one-year inventory supply arrangement in which Broadcom facilitates Synaptics' purchase orders with suppliers

source.label: Synaptics 10-K
source.quote: We also entered into transition agreements with Broadcom, under which both parties will provide one another with certain transition services (including one year inventory supply agreement in which Broadcom will facilitate Synaptics to place purchase orders with respective suppliers) following the Closing Date.

companies.sub: パワー・センシング半導体

relations.text: Synapticsはonsemiとの合併契約に基づき、特定の場合にonsemiへ解約手数料を支払う可能性がある
relations.text_en: Under its merger agreement with onsemi, Synaptics could be required in specified circumstances to pay a termination fee to onsemi

source.label: Synaptics 10-K
source.quote: The Merger Agreement contains provisions that could discourage or deter a potential competing acquirer from making a favorable alternative transaction proposal to us and, in specified circumstances, could require us to pay a substantial termination fee to onsemi.

relations.text: 合併の成否は、Synapticsとonsemiの事業統合がうまく進むかに左右される
relations.text_en: The success of the merger depends in part on Synaptics and onsemi integrating their operations

source.label: Synaptics 10-K
source.quote: The success of the Merger, including anticipated benefits and cost savings, will depend, in part, on our and onsemi's ability to successfully integrate our respective operations in a manner that results in various benefits and that does not materially disrupt existing business and strategic relationships or result in a loss of customers.

source.quote: The collaboration will integrate Google's ML core with Synaptics Astra AI-Native hardware and open-source software to accelerate the development of context-aware devices.

relations.text: GoogleのMLIR準拠のML coreをSynaptics Astraハードウェアに載せ、オープンソースのソフトとツールと組み合わせる

source.label: Synaptics — Google edge-AI collaboration, January 2, 2025
source.quote: The collaboration will integrate Google’s MLIR-compliant ML core on the Synaptics Astra TM hardware with open-source software and tools.
